package main

import "unsafe"

//go:linkname write runtime.write
func write(fd uintptr, p unsafe.Pointer, n int32) int32

//go:linkname exit syscall.Exit
func exit(code int)

// big is written to fd 1 in one runtime.write: long enough that a host taking a stream write in pieces
// leaves a partial copy, which write1 must loop on.
var big [70 << 10]byte

func main() {
	println("hello")
	for i := range big {
		if i%64 == 63 {
			big[i] = '\n'
		} else {
			big[i] = 'a' + byte(i%26)
		}
	}
	n := write(1, unsafe.Pointer(&big[0]), int32(len(big)))
	println("wrote", n, "of", len(big))
	exit(3)
}
